question: What are the best alternatives to the ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station?
query: best alternatives ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station 2026 comparison Belkin Anker UGREEN

replays.text:
The **UGREEN Nexode 100W with 15W wireless charging station** is the closest alternative if you want the ESR’s mix of magnetic phone charging and high-wattage wired power. It has 100W GaN output, two USB-C ports and one USB-A port, but **no built-in Apple Watch charger**. [iMore’s review](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)

Other good picks depend on what you want to keep:

- **Anker 3-in-1 Cube with MagSafe — best for iPhone, Watch and AirPods.** It has a retractable Watch charger and a spot for AirPods, but it’s not the choice if you need the ESR’s high-output laptop charging. [iMore’s best MagSafe stands](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Anker 737 MagGo 3-in-1 Station — best as a dedicated Apple-device charging stand.** It offers 15W MagSafe charging plus Watch and AirPods charging; the trade-off is a bulky design. [iMore’s guide](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1 — best if you only need phone and Watch charging.** It’s an elegant stand, but it doesn’t cover AirPods or the ESR’s extra USB charging ports. [iMore’s guide](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)

**Quick take:** Choose UGREEN if wired power and ports matter most; choose the Anker Cube if you want a compact Apple-device trio. None of these quite replicates the ESR’s combination of Watch charging and 100W wired output in one station.

The **closest alternative is the UGREEN Nexode 100W with 15W MagSafe**: it combines MagSafe charging with 100W GaN power and two USB-C ports plus USB-A, so it’s the best fit if you want to charge a laptop and other wired devices alongside your phone. The tradeoff: it has **no Apple Watch charger**. [iMore’s review](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)

Other good picks, depending on what matters most:

- **Anker 3-in-1 Cube with MagSafe** — best if you want a compact Apple-device station: it charges an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, with an adjustable phone angle. It’s less of a laptop-charging hub than the UGREEN. [iMore’s MagSafe stand guide](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Anker 737 MagGo 3-in-1 Station** — a more traditional desk or nightstand option for iPhone, Watch, and AirPods, with 15W MagSafe charging. It’s described as bulky, so it’s better left in one place. [iMore’s guide](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1** — a polished choice if you only need to charge an iPhone and Apple Watch; it doesn’t match the ESR’s broader device-and-port setup. [iMore’s guide](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)

**My quick take:** Choose UGREEN for the closest high-power alternative, or the Anker Cube if charging your Watch and AirPods matters more than having 100W wired charging.

The best alternative depends on what you want to keep from the ESR’s feature set:

- **Closest for laptop charging: [UGREEN Nexode 100W with 15W MagSafe](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)** — It pairs MagSafe charging with 100W GaN power and USB-A/USB-C ports, so it can charge a laptop and other devices too. It’s sturdy and compact, but **doesn’t have a built-in Apple Watch charger**. Best if 100W wired charging matters more than an all-in-one Apple setup.

- **Best for iPhone, Watch, and AirPods: [Anker 3-in-1 Cube](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)** — A compact, polished option with MagSafe, a retractable Apple Watch charger, and a spot for AirPods. It’s a better fit for bedside or desk charging, but it **doesn’t replace the ESR as a 100W laptop-charging hub**.

- **Best if you want a larger 3-in-1 stand: [Anker 737 MagGo 3-in-1 Station](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)** — It offers 15W MagSafe charging for iPhone plus Apple Watch and AirPods charging. The trade-off is its bulk, and it isn’t presented as a 100W multi-port laptop charger.

- **Simple two-device option: [Belkin BoostCharge Pro](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)** — A stylish MagSafe-and-Apple-Watch stand if you don’t need the ESR’s extra device charging or USB ports.

**My pick:** choose the **UGREEN** if you want the ESR’s high-wattage charging and can do without the Watch charger. Choose the **Anker Cube** if charging your iPhone, Watch, and AirPods together is the priority.
